normalisation: Stored graph paths are portable basenames. Rule text is regenerated unambiguously from numeric birth/survival masks (counts 10 and 11 use bracket notation); original mining simulation used these masks. The final C++ output formatter has the same correction.
searchLimitations: Screening uses a 64-bit repeated-state hash, with full-state production verification for the selected launcher.
Trials are executed samples and may repeat identical seeds; they are not counts of distinct configurations.
The retained elite audit is not an exhaustive nonexistence result.
Larger local transplants can change later behaviour because Penrose environments differ.
